title: Willa and the Blue Mitten
youtube_title: Willa and the Blue Mitten | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness means noticing what was dropped and taking the trouble to return it.
summary: During the lantern walk, Willa finds a blue mitten on a garden wall. She carries it carefully until she finds Mrs. Pell, whose hand was cold, and returns it with a smile.
